content.text: thou art cursed above all cattle, Gen. 3:14. cursed is the ground for thy sake, Gen. 3:17 (3:17–19). now art thou cursed from the earth, Gen. 4:11 (Moses 5:36). Lord set a mark upon Cain, Gen. 4:15 (Moses 5:40). ground which the Lord hath cursed, Gen. 5:29 (Moses 8:9). not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, Gen. 8:21. Cursed be Canaan, Gen. 9:25. I will … curse him that curseth thee, Gen. 12:3 (27:29). Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce, Gen. 49:7. he that curseth his father, or his mother, Ex. 21:17 (Lev. 20:9; Prov. 20:20; Matt. 15:4; Mark 7:10). Thou shalt not … curse the ruler, Ex. 22:28. Thou shalt not curse the deaf, Lev. 19:14. Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin, Lev. 24:15. set before you this day a blessing and a curse, Deut. 11:26. God turned the curse into a blessing, Deut. 23:5. Cursed be the man that maketh any graven … image, Deut. 27:15. Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words, Deut. 27:26. all these curses shall come upon thee, Deut. 28:15. all the curses that are written in this book, Deut. 29:20. God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, Deut. 30:7. set before you life and death, blessing and cursing, Deut. 30:19. Cursed be the man … that … buildeth this city, Josh. 6:26. he read … blessings and cursings, Josh. 8:34. that they should become a desolation and a curse, 2 Kgs. 22:19. bring evil … even all the curses that are written, 2 Chr. 34:24. entered into a curse, and into an oath, Neh. 10:29. sinned, and cursed God in their hearts, Job 1:5. curse thee to thy face, Job 1:11. touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee, Job 2:5. curse God, and die, Job 2:9. opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day, Job 3:1. suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse, Job 31:30. His mouth is full of cursing and deceit, Ps. 10:7. they that be cursed of him shall be cut off, Ps. 37:22. bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly, Ps. 62:4. Let them curse, but bless thou, Ps. 109:28. curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked, Prov. 3:33. it shall be counted a curse, Prov. 27:14. the curse devoured the earth, Isa. 24:6. come down … upon the people of my curse, Isa. 34:5. Cursed be the man that obeyeth not, Jer. 11:3. Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, Jer. 17:5 (2 Ne. 4:34; 28:31). Cursed be the day wherein I was born, Jer. 20:14. to make them a desolation … and a curse, Jer. 25:18. Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, Jer. 48:10. transgressed … therefore the curse is poured upon us, Dan. 9:11. ye were a curse among the heathen, Zech. 8:13. cursed be the deceiver, Mal. 1:14. I will even send a curse upon you, Mal. 2:2. cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, Mal. 3:9 (3 Ne. 24:9). come and smite the earth with a curse, Mal. 4:6 (3 Ne. 25:6).

bless them that curse you, Matt. 5:44 (Luke 6:28; 3 Ne. 12:44). Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, Matt. 25:41. Then began he to curse, Matt. 26:74 (Mark 14:71). fig tree which thou cursedst is withered, Mark 11:21. people who knoweth not the law are cursed, John 7:49. bound themselves under a curse, Acts 23:12. Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not, Rom. 12:14. Cursed is every one that continueth not, Gal. 3:10. Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, Gal. 3:13. therewith curse we men, James 3:9. they have … cursed children, 2 Pet. 2:14. there shall be no more curse, Rev. 22:3.

curse them even with a sore curse, 1 Ne. 2:23. Lord did curse the land, 1 Ne. 17:35. wicked he destroyeth, and curseth the land, 1 Ne. 17:38. a cursing should come upon you, 2 Ne. 1:18. ye may not be cursed with a sore cursing, 2 Ne. 1:22. that the cursing may be taken from you, 2 Ne. 4:6. he had caused the cursing to come upon them, 2 Ne. 5:21. because of their cursing which was upon them, 2 Ne. 5:24. but ye have cursed them, 2 Ne. 29:5. keep my commandments … or cursed be the land, Jacob 2:29. except ye repent the land is cursed, Jacob 3:3. they brought upon themselves the curse, Alma 3:19. curse of God had fallen upon them, Alma 17:15. curse of God did no more follow them, Alma 23:18. I have brought this great curse upon me, Alma 30:53. more cursed is he that knoweth the will of God, Alma 32:19. the cursing and the blessing of God, Alma 45:16. cursed because of your riches, Hel. 13:21. curse was taken from them, 3 Ne. 2:15.

ye that hear me not will I curse, D&C 41:1. in the last days … I cursed the waters, D&C 61:14. Lord, in the beginning cursed the land, D&C 61:17. Cursed are all those that shall lift up the heel, D&C 121:16. whoever he curses shall be cursed, D&C 124:93. smitten with a curse unless there is a welding link, D&C 128:18.

a cursing which I will put upon thee, Moses 5:25. cursed from the earth which hath opened her mouth, Moses 5:36. cursed Lamech, and his house, Moses 5:52. famine … the Lord cursed the earth, Moses 8:4. sprang that race which preserved the curse in the land, Abr. 1:24. cursed him as pertaining to the Priesthood, Abr. 1:26. curse them that curse thee, Abr. 2:11.
